question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

All along

options.text: All the time; from the beginning

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. All the time; from the beginning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"All along"** means continuously or throughout a particular period of time. (पूरे समय; शुरू से)

 
 
• **Example:** I knew all along that he was lying.
 
 
 
• **"All the time; from the beginning"** means the entire duration or from the start until the end. (पूरे समय; शुरुआत से)
 
 
• **Example:** She had been planning this surprise all along.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. All the time; from the beginning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Everywhere** (हर जगह): In, to, or at every place or location.

 
 
• **Example:** You can find coffee shops everywhere in this city.
 
 
 
• **At the desired place** (मनचाही जगह पर): In the location that is wanted or required.
 
 
• **Example:** She finally found herself at the desired place in her career.
 
 
 
• **People in unity** (लोग एकता में): Individuals working together harmoniously.
 
 
• **Example:** The people in unity were able to achieve great things.
